limits.rng: Local sha256-rowkeys-v1, not Google RNG oracle or selected-row parity; uniform[0,1), normal Box-Muller
limits.keys: Default system:index property then Feature.id; missing/null/complex/nonfinite reject. Row-key strings<=4096 Unicode codepoints; numeric abs<=2^53; Boolean type distinct; signed zero normalized; <=64 unique ordered names. Explicit[] produces one shared draw; duplicate values yield same draw
limits.schema: Flat UTF8 names<=256codepoints, noNUL or dot; output cannot system:index/.geo. New column before.geo; overwritten column retains position; source band_order unchanged. <=16 operations,256columns,1000rows,50000cells,1MB CSV/JSON
limits.budgets: 16384 UTF8bytes/operation; compiler/table-op/MD50000 work; RF prior50000,object-copy150000,wire3MB. Compound budgets can reject far smaller datasets than shape ceilings; no promise all1000-row workflows fit
limits.cache: <=64 entries per translator, exact immutable input identity and strong references, frozen origin/headers, fresh caller copies, hit/miss/copy work precharged; no rows/models cached
